name: Siteline Agent Analytics
author: sitelineai

sections.description:
Agent Analytics from Siteline helps you understand how AI agents and bots crawl, ingest, and interact with your website content in real-time. Turn AI visibility optimization from a black box into data-driven action.

This is the official Siteline plugin.

Features

  • Real-time monitoring: Monitor real-time visits to your website by AI bots and agents from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and more.
  • Server-side tracking: Works even when bots do not execute JavaScript.
  • Identify technical blockers: Identify where bots and agents are getting stuck when trying to learn about your brand and products.
  • Find trending topics: Optimize your content strategy based on what AI agents and real ChatGPT users are looking for.
  • No plan required: All you need is a free Siteline account. No credit card required.
  • Simple setup: Just create an account, generate a Website ID, and start tracking.
  • Lightweight and privacy-focused: No frontend JavaScript and minimal performance impact. Non-blocking async tracking that respects user privacy.

Why Track AI Agents?

AI platforms are increasingly important traffic sources for organic growth. However, content ingestion by AI platforms differs significantly from traditional search engines:

  • AI bots and agents regularly visit websites to collect, update, and verify information not only for training large language models, but also to power real-time AI search and live answers.
  • This crawling behavior determines which content is available and ingested into AI chat assistants and how your brand and products are represented in AI-generated responses.
  • Importantly, AI bots behave differently than traditional search crawlers. Most do not run JavaScript or maintain cookies or session state. If your site relies heavily on JavaScript or is not server-side rendered, your content may not be ingested correctly.

Understanding which AI agents, bots, and crawlers visit your site helps you:

  • Identify technical blockers, such as JavaScript-heavy pages limiting content ingestion.
  • Discover what topics AI agents and user-initiated fetches access most frequently.
  • Understand the full AI discovery journey, from bot content ingestion to human visits and conversions.

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a free Siteline account
  2. Generate a unique Website ID
  3. Enter the Website ID in the plugin settings
  4. Enable tracking and you’re done

External Services

This plugin connects to the Siteline service to track AI agent and bot visits.

Service: Siteline
Service URL: https://siteline.ai
API endpoint: https://api.siteline.ai

Data transmitted:
• Page URL
• User agent
• Referrer URL
• IP address
• Website ID

Purpose:
This data is used to identify AI agents and analyze how they access your website.

Privacy policy:
https://siteline.ai/privacy

Terms of service:
https://siteline.ai/terms

Support

Need help? Visit our documentation:
https://docs.siteline.ai/integrations/wordpress

Or contact:
team@siteline.ai
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Siteline Agent Analytics”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings > Siteline in your WordPress admin
  2. Check “Enable Tracking”
  3. Enter your Website ID from siteline.ai
  4. Click “Save Changes”

If you have not authorized your website yet, follow the authorization guide:
https://docs.siteline.ai/authorization
sections.faq:
Do I need a Siteline account?

Yes. You need a free Siteline account to generate a Website ID and view analytics.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. The plugin uses non-blocking async requests that do not impact page load times.

What AI platforms do you track?

We track all major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Mode / AI Overviews, and many others.

Is this GDPR compliant?

The plugin is designed to track bot and agent activity. Site owners are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable privacy laws.

Does this work with caching plugins?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with all major caching plugins.

Can I use this with other analytics plugins?

Yes. Siteline works alongside Google Analytics, Matomo, and other analytics tools.
